title: End-of-life snapshot
description: Offline copy of endoflife.date release cycles, written by bin/eol-snapshot.mjs and read by bin/eol-scan.mjs. Field names are endoflife.date's (cycle, eol, codename); the compact shape is commitwork's. eol is a date, true (ended, date unpublished), false (not ended), or null (upstream value unreadable).
$comment: OASIS OpenEoX Core (CSD01, 2026-07-13) maps eol dates to end_of_life, but has no boolean or null form, so it is not the storage shape. No $ref: monitor/registry.mjs refuses it.
